```{r}
#| label: cshq-ancova-interaction-unadjusted
#| include: false

cshq_var <- c("cshq_ts")
cshq_label <- c("Total Sleep Disturbance")

names(cshq_label) = cshq_var

# fit ANCOVA models with Treatment*Age Group interaction (unadjusted for demographics)
cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj <- lapply(
  cshq_var,
  function(x) fit_ancova_interaction(
    dataset = data,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = cshq_label[x],
    demo_vars = NULL,
    covariates = NULL,
    strata_var = strata_var,
    strata_label = strata_label
  )
)
names(cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj) <- cshq_label

# extract tables from fit_ancova_interaction output
cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj),
    function(x) {
      cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cshq-ancova-interaction-unadjusted
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "CSHQ - Unadjusted ANCOVA results with Treatment*Age Group interaction showing LS means (95% CI)
#|    for baseline and 16-week change, and between-group difference in changes stratified by age group
#|    (not adjusted for demographics). {data_caption}")

cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft <- cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary |>
  dplyr::select(-interaction_p) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    Age_Group = "Age Group",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_p = "Week 16",
    week16_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "Change",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_m = "Week 16",
    week16_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "Change",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "Change Diff",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    interaction_est = "Interaction Estimate",
    interaction_ci = "95% CI"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences", ""),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 7, 7, 4, 2)
  ) |>
  flextable::merge_v(j = c("Outcome", "interaction_est", "interaction_ci")) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1:2, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::align(j = c(21, 22), align = "center", part = "body") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(2, 9, 16), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-cshq-ancova-interaction-unadjusted-forest
#| fig-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "CSHQ - Forest plot showing Treatment*Age Group interaction term (unadjusted). {data_caption}")

plot_ancova_interaction_forest(
  obj = cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj,
  labels = cshq_label,
  min_mult = 1.1,
  max_mult = 1.1,
  arrow_labs = strata_levels
)
```
